title: Metz
summary: Metz is the chairman of the Huntik Foundation and was the mentor of Dante Vale throughout his childhood. For a long period of time, he was bedridden due to the Curse of the Legendary Titans but, after this was lifted, recovered and returned to his position as the head of the Huntik Foundation Council.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Image caption: Simon saves Metz' life

In the mid-late 1950s, Metz, as a young Seeker, became acquainted with Simon Judeau and young Eathon Lambert, whom he met by chance on a street in Venice, Italy. Forming an inseparable Seeker team, together the trio embarked on many adventures, travelling to many different locations, including Peru. Within the group, Metz served as the muscle, Judeau the brains, and Eathon as the intuition, [The Secret of Two Generations] At one point in their travels, Simon saved Metz' life at the Temple of Tecobai during an attack from the Ecuadorian natives, by holding out his Caliban Amulet to stop him falling into a river of lava. [The Divine Comedy]

This all changed, however, the day that they tried to find one of the Legendary Titans, Araknos. Upon arriving at the Titan's resting place, Metz read the ancient scripts carved on the door of Araknos' Tomb and decided that they should leave the Titan. Simon however threw caution to the winds and forcefully entered the tomb but was cursed by ancient magic. [The Secret of Two Generations]

While Simon went into intensive care in the Huntik Foundation, Metz went off to try and find another Legendary Titan with the hope of harnessing its power to cure Simon. [The Secret of Two Generations] On his travels, he saved the life of a young Amazon queen in Turkey. They got romantically involved, and he took her to the outside world, marrying her in the Cathedral of Notre Dame. She died some time after that, however. [Ladies' Choice]

Some time later, he met young Dante Vale and, seeing his potential as a Seeker, taught him Seeker abilities, even giving him the Amulet of the powerful Caliban. Metz eventually found the resting place of the Legendary Titan, Behemoth, however upon trying to take it from its resting place, he was cursed like Simon. [Ladies' Choice]

After this failed attempt at curing Simon's curse, Metz himself became critically ill due to the curse, which also attacked his will. He was placed under around the clock care under Lady S., a Foundation medic. Throughout this time, Metz received regular visits from Dante Vale, who promised to find a cure. During one of these visits, Metz was introduced to the new Huntik Foundation inductee, Zhalia Moon. After the actions of Lok Lambert sending the Legendary Titans back to the Spirit World, Metz made a full recovery from his afflictions was able to take part in celebrating the defeat of the Organization and the Professor with the rest of the Huntik Foundation. [The Mission]

Afterwards, Metz returned to his place as head of the Huntik Foundation Council where he discussed the Blood Spiral Brotherhood with the council and presented the masked council member to the rest of the council as Teien Casterwill. [The Casterwill Connection]

sections.heading: Personality
sections.text:
Metz told Dante that he believed that stopping the Organization was more important then saving his life. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]
When he was a trio with Simon and Eathon, he was considered the "muscle man" of the team (Simon was the intelligent one and Eathon the intuitive one). [The Secret of Two Generations]

His old friend, Master Storm, called Metz a lady-killer and a daredevil, indicating that, in his past, Metz was a brave man and hit with the ladies. [Lok's Leadership] He seems to be a real gentleman, has excellent manners, charm that appeals to women and a good sense of humour. He is also well-liked by his colleagues and subordinates. [The Casterwill Connection] He is a great leader, always a step ahead his subordinates. When Momax feared that the teams are too small, Metz told him that he already took care of it. [The Tower of Nostradamus] He is responsible and always acts in the best interests of his Seekers, seen when he immediately contacted Dante when he suspected Lok and his team were in trouble. [S2E43]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S1E24_Metz_invokes_Ariel.jpg|thumb|Teenage Metz summons [[Ariel]]]] In his teenage years, Metz provided the muscle and combat ability in his [[Seeker]] team. {{source|The Secret of Two Generations}} As the leader of the Foundation, Metz now has a highly developed repertoire of spells to choose from and a vast collection of Titans. He owned the powerful [[Caliban]], given to him by his best friend Simon, which he later gave to his young charge, Dante. {{Source|S1E18}} 

When suffering from the [[Curse of the Legendary Titans]], Metz was bedridden and was unable to cast spells or invoke his Titans. {{Source|S1E09}} Since the curse was lifted, he feels better and healthier than ever, and is able to use his powers once again. {{Source|S1E26}} He is a strong leader and skilled co-ordinator, able to make decisive decisions and mobilise his Seeker teams. A skilled fighter back in the day, Metz still bravely takes to the field when necessary, doing whatever he can to help and protect his allies. {{source|Dante's Return}}
sections.text:
Image caption: Teenage Metz summons Ariel

In his teenage years, Metz provided the muscle and combat ability in his Seeker team. [The Secret of Two Generations] As the leader of the Foundation, Metz now has a highly developed repertoire of spells to choose from and a vast collection of Titans. He owned the powerful Caliban, given to him by his best friend Simon, which he later gave to his young charge, Dante. [S1E18]

When suffering from the Curse of the Legendary Titans, Metz was bedridden and was unable to cast spells or invoke his Titans. [S1E09] Since the curse was lifted, he feels better and healthier than ever, and is able to use his powers once again. [S1E26] He is a strong leader and skilled co-ordinator, able to make decisive decisions and mobilise his Seeker teams. A skilled fighter back in the day, Metz still bravely takes to the field when necessary, doing whatever he can to help and protect his allies. [Dante's Return]

sections.heading: Bonded Titans
sections.text:
Ariel — given away — Metz's primary Titan when he was younger; he gave him to Dante to help him defeat his former best friend, the Professor.

Caliban — given away — Given by his best friend Simon Judeau after using his Amulet to save Metz's life; Metz gave it to Dante as a child and, years later, Dante gave it back to Simon believing he would save Metz once again.

Maelstrom — given away — Given to Dante to help him capture Rassimov and absorb his most dangerous powers.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
*Metz is named after the Metropolitan Museum of Art (or simply "The Met") located in New York. This is in keeping with how all the named members of the [[Huntik Foundation Council]] seem to be named after various museums around the world.
* Metz's name may also be derived from the German name ''Mätz'', a shortened form of Matthias or Matthew or from the German words ''messet'', ''metset'', or ''metz'' for knife. [[wikipedia:Metz|Metz]] is also the capital of the [[wikipedia:Lorraine (region)|Lorraine]] region of France which was named after the Gaolish tribe known as the Mediomatrici. {{extsource|1=http://www.ancestry.com/name-origin?surname=metz|2=Ancestry.com}}
*Metz's Titans appear to be based on characters from Shakespeare's ''[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Tempest The Tempest].'' [[Caliban]] and [[Ariel]] are both characters in the play, and both [[Maelstrom]] and Tempest can be used colloquially to refer to chaotic situations.
